routeName: Gunnison Gorge Chukar to Gunnison Forks

putIn.name: Chukar Boat Launch
putIn.note: Mapped river launch anchor; one-mile boat carry from the Recreation.gov Chukar Trailhead.

takeOut.name: Gunnison Forks Day-Use Recreation Site
takeOut.note: BLM public natural-surface river access at the North Fork confluence.

gauge.thresholdDisposition: No station-tied runnable band published; BLM feature cues are retained as planning context only.

safety.highClassHandling: Mandatory scout/portage language, cold-water and rescue readiness, remote-exit controls, and no assumption that a feature is runnable for any crew.

camping.rule: Designated BLM river camps only by wilderness registration/permit; Gunnison Forks is day-use only.

imagery.captionPosture: Same-river corridor context; not an endpoint or current-conditions photograph.

deduplication: Distinct 09128000 Gunnison Gorge wilderness reach; separate from existing 09114500 Almont/North Bridge and Whitewater Park routes.
